stockAnalysis.calculationDescription: Calculation: use TTM earnings per share with a target P/E of {{low}}–{{high}}, then add valuation net cash per share of {{netCash}} (negative when the company has net debt). The watch range applies a 20% margin of safety to the lower end of fair value.
stockAnalysis.lossMakingDescription: Current TTM earnings per share is {{eps}}. Earnings are negative, so a target P/E cannot produce a meaningful fair value. Consider P/S, EV/Sales, cash levels and the path to profitability instead.
stockAnalysis.pegWarning: PEG is unavailable because no reliable EPS growth rate is available, and it is not used to adjust the target multiple.
stockAnalysis.cashBufferDescription: Cash and short-term investments per share are {{cash}}, debt per share is {{debt}}, and valuation net cash per share is {{netCash}}, approximately {{percentage}} of the current share price.
stockAnalysis.disclaimer: This range is produced by a rule-based model using available snapshot data. It is neither a real-time quote nor investment advice. Decisions should also consider earnings growth, debt, cash flow, the industry cycle and the latest announcements.

rules.maDescription: A larger distance from MA20 means price is farther from its short-to-medium-term balance. Combined with a high RSI, it can indicate overheating.
rules.volumeDescription: Volume ratio = current volume / five-day average volume. A ratio above 1.2 with a price rise indicates stronger participation.
rules.combinationDescription: The strongest combination is usually rising price, expanding volume and increasing distance; high distance with weak volume warrants caution.

messages.ETF_OVERHEATED: {{ticker}}: RSI is {{rsi}} and price is {{deviation}} above MA20; short-term conditions are overheated.
messages.ETF_OVERSOLD: {{ticker}}: RSI is {{rsi}}; momentum is weak and in the oversold watch zone.
messages.ETF_VOLUME_CONFIRMED: {{ticker}}: price rose with a {{volumeRatio}} volume ratio, confirming the move.
messages.ETF_LOW_VOLUME_EXTENSION: {{ticker}}: price is {{deviation}} above MA20 but volume ratio is only {{volumeRatio}}; beware of low-volume chasing.
messages.EXTREME_GREED: CNN Fear & Greed is {{score}}; sentiment is in extreme greed.
messages.EXTREME_FEAR: CNN Fear & Greed is {{score}}; sentiment is in extreme fear.
messages.NO_ALERTS: No overheating, oversold, volume-confirmed rise or low-volume extension alert is active.
messages.SUMMARY_WITH_SENTIMENT: CNN Fear & Greed is {{score}}; among observed ETFs, {{up}} rose and {{down}} fell.
messages.SUMMARY_WITHOUT_SENTIMENT: CNN sentiment data is unavailable; among observed ETFs, {{up}} rose and {{down}} fell.

marketSummary.STRONG_BUT_OVERHEATED: Risk appetite is strong, but sentiment is overheated
marketSummary.HOT_BUT_DIVERGING: Sentiment is hot while price momentum diverges
marketSummary.FEAR_WITH_RECOVERY: Prices are recovering amid fearful sentiment
marketSummary.WEAK_AND_FEARFUL: Risk appetite is weak and sentiment is fearful
marketSummary.BULLISH_NON_EXTREME: Momentum is bullish without extreme sentiment
marketSummary.BEARISH: Momentum is bearish; manage downside risk
marketSummary.DIVERGING: Market direction is mixed; await a clearer signal

execution.HIGH_RISK: Multiple risk conditions are active. Reduce chasing and high-volatility exposure until RSI, MA distance or volume normalizes.
execution.SELECTIVE: Some risk conditions are active. Stay selective and confirm volume and MA distance before adding exposure.
execution.BULLISH: ETF momentum is broadly bullish with no major risk trigger. A bullish bias is reasonable with defined risk limits.
execution.DEFENSIVE: ETF momentum is broadly weak without a confirmed reversal. Keep exposure conservative and await a volume-backed recovery.
execution.NEUTRAL: Data is limited or direction is mixed. Maintain neutral exposure until price-volume signals become clearer.

analysisReport.industryFairValueDescription: The range uses the primary metric and AI industry-wide multiple assumptions, applied to current verified financial inputs. It is not an observed market range and does not fully adjust for each company's growth and risk.
analysisReport.backendOnly: All displayed analysis values come from the backend. The UI does not calculate fair value, buy ranges, RSI summaries, support/resistance, or trade decisions.
analysisReport.noPreferredPlan: No backend preferred plan is available.
analysisReport.preferredPlanMissing: The backend preferred plan is not present in this report.
analysisReport.positionSaved: Position saved. Re-run CURRENT analysis to use the new version.
analysisReport.accountOptional: Optional. Quantitative share sizing is unavailable unless all fields are supplied and applied. Percent fields are entered as 1 = 1%.
analysisReport.accountApplied: Account context applied; the report is being recalculated by the backend.
analysisReport.invalidAccountInput: Account inputs are incomplete or invalid.
analysisReport.unavailableExplanation: The required data has not been verified.
analysisReport.technicalPlanLimit: Entry zones, profit targets and stops have different purposes. A valuation observation does not activate a trade; market, event and execution conditions must also pass.
analysisReport.costAssumptions: Current model assumptions: 0.10% fee and 0.05% slippage on each side. These are modelling inputs, not your broker's actual charges.
analysisReport.scoreLimit: Evidence scores and confidence describe the available evidence and agreement between signals. They are not win rates or probabilities of a price rise.
analysisReport.observationUnavailable: The backend has not supplied a verified valuation position.
analysisReport.observationLimit: At either boundary, the price remains within this method's range. An observation zone alone is not an instruction to buy or sell.
analysisReport.formulaUnavailable: See the model's verified calculation inputs.
analysisReport.historicalMethodDescription: The historical range applies the company's historical multiple distribution to current verified fundamentals. Its central value uses the historical median; historical pricing is a comparison, not a prediction.
analysisReport.industryMarketDescription: Observed market multiples are separate from fair-value assumptions. At least three distinct CIKs are required; the median is sampled by listed share class, so a company with several classes can carry multiple observations.
analysisReport.marketReferenceUnavailable: No same-date verified industry market comparison is available.
analysisReport.indicatorLimit: Indicators describe observed price and volume behaviour. A high or low reading alone does not establish the next price direction.
analysisReport.technicalDefinition: A descriptive measurement of the verified price series.
analysisReport.indicatorsUnavailable: Verified indicator data is not available.

formulas.PE: Verified TTM EPS × valuation P/E multiple
formulas.PB: Verified book value per share × valuation P/B multiple
formulas.PS: Verified TTM revenue per share × valuation P/S multiple
formulas.EV_EBITDA: (TTM EBITDA × multiple − debt + cash-like assets) ÷ shares
formulas.PFCF: Verified TTM free cash flow per share × historical P/FCF multiple

states.DEGRADED: Some data or checks are incomplete

interpretations.RSI_HIGH: Momentum is in a high RSI zone; this alone does not imply an imminent fall.
interpretations.RSI_LOW: Momentum is in a low RSI zone; this alone does not imply an imminent rebound.
interpretations.RSI_MID: RSI is between the high and low zones.
interpretations.MACD_ABOVE_SIGNAL: MACD is above the signal line. This is a current relationship, not proof of a new crossover.
interpretations.MACD_BELOW_SIGNAL: MACD is below the signal line. This is a current relationship, not proof of a new crossover.
interpretations.MACD_AT_SIGNAL: MACD is at the signal line.
interpretations.MA_PRICE_ABOVE: The close is above this moving average.
interpretations.MA_PRICE_BELOW: The close is below this moving average.
interpretations.MA_PRICE_AT: The close is at this moving average.
interpretations.VOLATILITY_MEASURE: This measures volatility, not price direction.
interpretations.BOLLINGER_ABOVE: The close is above the upper band; this alone is not a sell signal.
interpretations.BOLLINGER_BELOW: The close is below the lower band; this alone is not a buy signal.
interpretations.BOLLINGER_WITHIN: The close is within the Bollinger bands.
interpretations.MA_CROSS_UP: A moving-average upward crossover is confirmed by the compared periods.
interpretations.MA_CROSS_DOWN: A moving-average downward crossover is confirmed by the compared periods.
interpretations.MA_CROSS_NONE: No new moving-average crossover was detected.
interpretations.RANGE_POSITION: This measures position within a recent range; it is not a forecast.
interpretations.MEASURE_ONLY: A descriptive measurement; combine it with trend and risk context.

reasons.RSI_WARMUP_REQUIRED: More price history is required to publish a stable RSI.
reasons.MACD_WARMUP_REQUIRED: More price history is required to publish a stable MACD.
reasons.INDUSTRY_FAIR_RANGE_MISSING: Industry fair-value multiples have not been established.
reasons.INDUSTRY_PRIMARY_METRIC_MISSING: The industry's primary valuation metric has not been set.
reasons.PRICE_STALE: Prices are out of date; an executable plan cannot be issued.
reasons.ENTRY_EXPIRED: The opportunity to open this new entry has expired.
reasons.NO_FIXED_TARGET: There is no verified overhead resistance from which to set profit targets.
reasons.RR_BELOW_POLICY: Risk/reward after costs does not meet the trading policy.
reasons.MARKET_MEDIANS_UNAVAILABLE: Industry market samples or same-date observations are insufficient.

indicatorDefinitions.RSI14: Wilder RSI over 14 daily periods; momentum, not a price forecast.
indicatorDefinitions.ATR14: 14-period Wilder true-range average, in price units.
indicatorDefinitions.HV20: Annualised volatility of 20 daily log returns, expressed as a fraction.
indicatorDefinitions.STOCH_K14: Close position within the 14-period high/low range (%).
indicatorDefinitions.BOLLINGER_LOWER20: 20-period mean minus two population standard deviations.
indicatorDefinitions.BOLLINGER_UPPER20: 20-period mean plus two population standard deviations.
indicatorDefinitions.BOLLINGER_BANDWIDTH20: Band width divided by its middle line (fraction).
indicatorDefinitions.BOLLINGER_POSITION20: Position from lower to upper band (fraction); may exceed 0–1.
indicatorDefinitions.SLOPE5_MA20: Average percentage change per period in SMA20 over five periods.
indicatorDefinitions.SLOPE5_MA50: Average percentage change per period in SMA50 over five periods.
indicatorDefinitions.SLOPE5_MA200: Average percentage change per period in SMA200 over five periods.
indicatorDefinitions.MA20_50_CROSS: SMA20 / SMA50 crossover compared with the preceding period.
indicatorDefinitions.MA_COMPRESSION: Spread of SMA20/50/100 divided by the close (fraction).
indicatorDefinitions.MA_EXTENSION_ATR: Close minus SMA20, divided by ATR14.
indicatorDefinitions.SMA20: Simple average of 20 daily closes, in price units.
indicatorDefinitions.SMA50: Simple average of 50 daily closes, in price units.
indicatorDefinitions.SMA100: Simple average of 100 daily closes, in price units.
indicatorDefinitions.SMA150: Simple average of 150 daily closes, in price units.
indicatorDefinitions.SMA200: Simple average of 200 daily closes, in price units.
indicatorDefinitions.EMA20: 20-period exponential moving average of daily closes.
indicatorDefinitions.EMA50: 50-period exponential moving average of daily closes.
